texto_fixo.trava: CHARACTER LOCK: Garota. Appearance: slim young woman, very long straight glossy black hair parted in the middle with two thin loose strands sticking up, big round gray eyes with small pupils and long lower lashes, small nose, soft pink blush, a loose burgundy knit cardigan over a dark charcoal camisole, dark gray lounge pants, barefoot, fair skin. Keep exactly the same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, body, outfit and colors in every image (follow the approved design reference).
texto_fixo.estilo: ART STYLE: 2D anime TV-series style, clean line art, flat cel shading, vibrant colors.
texto_fixo.regras: ONE single figure, framed as the pose says, seen in a 3/4 view turned to the RIGHT side of the image, the whole figure inside the image with margin. NO furniture, NO chair, NO table, NO desk, NO floor, NO background objects (a sitting pose sits on NOTHING — an invisible CHAIR-HEIGHT seat: hips at knee height, thighs level, lower legs down to the feet; NEVER sitting on the floor or kneeling unless the pose says so; the furniture is a separate layer); a small handheld object only if the pose needs it. No panels, on a flat solid chroma-key green background (#00FF00), no shadow on the background. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT in the image: no letters, no words, no speech balloons, no thought bubbles, no sound-effect onomatopoeia lettering, no captions, no narration boxes, no signs or labels with writing, no watermark. If the reference images contain speech balloons, lettering or sound effects, do NOT copy them.
